prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1043; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss. Insured reports a collision at an intersection while turning left. Claimant vehicle was reported proceeding straight through on the opposing approach. Police report requested. No citation information yet confirmed.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured. Insured states the left-turn signal was yellow and the oncoming vehicle entered the intersection at speed. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file. Scene diagram pending from insured.

Entry 3: Claimant is represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact with claimant to route through attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and prior claims history through counsel. Demand package not yet received.

Entry 4: Attorney's office reports claimant treated for neck and back strain following the collision. Treatment records requested with signed authorization. Claimant's vehicle inspection scheduled. Liability remains disputed pending review of the police report and witness statements.

Entry 5: Police report received. Report notes disputed right-of-way and lists the insured as turning left. Independent witness statement requested. Reserve reviewed and adjusted for medical exposure. File remains open pending receipt of medical records and the attorney's demand.
